title: console: 47 native <select> elements beside the shared Select/Combobox — the Group panel, the validation editor and Explain access among them
body:
**Filing gate ② — a product decision only the maintainer can make.**

**Who acts on it:** objectui maintainer (components owner) — a decision on the select primitive. ⛔ Not a claim. Filed on the maintainer's word: 「选择框不统一：分组面板、校验规则编辑器、Explain access 用的是浏览器原生 <select>，其他地方是带搜索的下拉框」.

## Maintainer quick-read

Settle on one select primitive? 47 native `<select>` elements in 30 source files (tests and comments excluded) sit beside the shared Select and Combobox, so the same kind of control looks and behaves differently from panel to panel.

## Seen

- List *Group* panel (`grouping-editor` in components): native select, while the Filter panel next to it uses comboboxes.
- Validation rule editor (`ObjectValidationsPanel`): Type / Status / Severity are native selects; in a read-only package they look editable (objectstack-ai/objectui#11781).
- *Explain access* (`AccessExplainPanel`): the object picker is a native select of 24 objects with no search.
- A `NativeSelect` wrapper exists in components but has no callers.

## Options

- **A** — shared Select for short fixed lists, Combobox (with search) above a threshold; a lint rule against raw `<select>` outside the primitive; migrate in passes.
- **B** — move only the long-list pickers (objects, fields) to Combobox.
- **C** — status quo.

## Recommendation

A, starting with the three surfaces above.

## Environment

Source read on objectui `main` at `82500a7` and objectstack `main` at `033e5c53`. Live observations are from the 2026-10-07 browser QA pass: `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` (objectstack `879bd38c`), console from objectui `179f6fe9`, Chromium 141 at 1440×900, signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai`.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *native select element inconsistent with searchable combobox Select component styling*: 8 hits (0 open, 8 closed).
- No hit describes this.
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: native select inconsistent combobox · raw select element studio · explain access object picker no search

Filed by Claude Code (session `session_01D76mrPJrSSdaKRxR2rvrMG`) from the 2026-10-07 QA pass and a follow-up source reading.
